contentList.content: When a spell damages you, you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.

Costs a tenth of your maximum hit points (never your last one). Everyone else within 4.5 m of you, allies too, takes 3d8 necrotic damage, 6d8 if right next to you (Dexterity save for half). Once per short rest.
Gain 5 experience per character level at the start of each of your turns in a fight.
Gain 10 JP for your job at the start of each of your turns in a fight.
3 bolts that each hit a creature you pick within 18 m (the same one more than once if you like), no attack roll: 1d8 thunder (wind) damage each. Once per short rest.
Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d4 extra damage.

Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d6 extra damage.

Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d8 extra damage.

Piercing damage you take is reduced by 3.
Revive a dead ally and heal it for 4d8. Once per long rest.

Ranged weapon attack at the arms: your weapon's damage, and the target makes a Constitution save against your manoeuvre DC or is Disabled for 1 turn (no actions or bonus actions). Once per short rest.

A burst of blade energy that flies 9 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 2d10 force, and 4d10 more force if the target is below half its hit points (FFT: damage grows with the HP it has lost). Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you make a Dexterity save or take 1d8 slashing damage (2d8 from level 5, 3d8 from level 11).
Hurl your fighting spirit at a creature up to 9 m away: ranged unarmed attack roll, 1d10 + your unarmed attack modifier force damage.
When you take damage, regain 1d4+2 HP. Once per turn.
Mega Flare: enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 8d8 force damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
Melee weapon attack that strikes four times, each strike dealing half your weapon's damage (one attack roll for all four). Once per short rest.
Sing for up to 3 turns (concentration; one song or dance at a time): you and allies within 9 m of you get +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage.
You can Speak with Animals at will. Always on while Orator is your job. (FFT: talk skills work on monsters; here they always do.)
A creature within 18 m gains Faith for 3 turns: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, but -2 to saving throws (strengthen an ally's magic, or soften an enemy). Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you take 3d6 psychic damage and are Silenced for 1 turn (Wisdom save: half damage, no silence; FFT drains MP). Once per short rest.

A burst of blade energy that flies 9 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 2d8 force, and 3d8 more force while you are below half your hit points (FFT: damage grows with the HP you've lost). Once per short rest.
6d6 cold damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.

1d8 cold damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.
Bite a creature next to you (melee weapon attack roll): 2d6 piercing + 2d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt. Not against undead or constructs. Once per short rest.

A burst of blade energy that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 1d8 force. At will.
When a weapon attack hits you, you get +1 to attack rolls for 10 turns.

Every foe within 12 m makes a Wisdom save or is Stopped, Immobilized and Disabled for 1 turn (bosses shrug off Stop). Once per long rest.

3 bolts that each hit a creature you pick within 18 m (the same one more than once if you like), no attack roll: 1d4 psychic damage each, and each bolt has a 1 in 5 chance of each of Blinded, Silenced, Frightened and Poisoned for 2 turns. Once per short rest.

A ring of blue flame: enemies within 5 m of you take 8d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.

Holy energy that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 2d8 radiant, and the target makes a Constitution save or is Doomed (it falls when the count ends; bosses shrug it off). Once per long rest.
Heal yourself and every ally within 9 m for 5d8+5. Once per long rest.

A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Doomed: it dies when Doom runs out after 3 turns. Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.

Only in shadow or darkness. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 10 chance of being turned to Stone for 2 turns.

A slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and knocks the target's headwear off; it falls to the ground.

A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Confused for 2 turns (it repeats the save each turn). Once per short rest.

+2 damage with versatile weapons (longswords, spears, quarterstaffs, ...) held in both hands.

Advantage on Wisdom saving throws (most talk skills and charms aim at Wisdom).
